description:
optional, enumerated string filter
Filter item prices based on their period_unit. Possible values are : day, week, month, year.
Supported operators : is, is_not, in, not_in

Example → period_unit[is] = "month"

is.description: \* \`day\` - A period of 24 hours. \* \`week\` - A period of 7 days. \* \`month\` - A period of 1 calendar month. \* \`year\` - A period of 1 calendar year.

is_not.description: \* \`day\` - A period of 24 hours. \* \`week\` - A period of 7 days. \* \`month\` - A period of 1 calendar month. \* \`year\` - A period of 1 calendar year.
